description: This file contains implementation for squaring functions in a big number (BIGNUM) library used in cryptographic code, including the BN_sqr function and an internal helper, bn_sqr_normal.

methods.name: int BN_sqr(BIGNUM * r,BIGNUM * a,BN_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Performs squaring of a BIGNUM 'a' into 'r', utilizing a context 'ctx' for temporary variables. Includes optimizations for small sizes (4 and 8 words) and calls internal helper for normal squaring.

methods.name: void bn_sqr_normal(BN_ULONG * r,BN_ULONG * a,int n,BN_ULONG * tmp)
methods.description: Internal helper function that performs the core squaring operation of big numbers, optimized for larger sizes, involving multiplication and addition of words.
